name: Garner
seo_title: Garner Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Garner, North Carolina for 2026: 4 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Garner packs its Christmas into one downtown weekend, with a tree lighting on Friday night and a block party and parade on Saturday.
celebrates: Garner kicks off the season in downtown with Light Up Main, a tree lighting where families shop with downtown businesses and local vendors, eat from food trucks and watch live performances from local groups. Santa visits during the evening, and everyone gathers at 7 pm for the lighting. The next afternoon the Town of Garner hosts a free Holiday Block Party at the Garner Recreation Center on West Main Street, with kids' crafts, games, music and pictures with Santa. That evening the Garner Optimist Club's Christmas Parade rolls down Main Street. Because the events sit within a few blocks of each other, families can walk between them.
lastyear: The Garner Optimist Club's parade website describes a parade run by volunteers who work with the Garner Police Department on safety, with driver and vehicle checks and wide buffers between vehicles and walking participants. Downtown Garner promotes Light Up Main as the event that officially kicks off the holiday season in town. We did not find a published 2025 recap with attendance or highlights, so the 2026 listings on this page come straight from the host websites. Check each host page for current times and parking.
facts: Garner's parade has a different theme each year, and the 2026 theme from the parade website is Tradition, Community and Home. Long-sleeve parade T-shirts are sold at the Optimist tree lot or next to the big Christmas tree on parade day. The Town of Garner's block party offers the Garner Express, a 24-person train ride around the outdoor walking trail, and parking at Avery Street Recreation Center and Garner Recreational Park. Light Up Main is held downtown, and the Town of Garner calls it an annual celebration.
trains: Garner has its own small train ride, the Garner Express, a 24-person train that circles the outdoor walking trail at the Holiday Block Party, so you do not need to leave town for a first train ride. For a bigger Christmas train, the Holiday Express at Pullen Park in Raleigh lists tickets at $21 on our museum page. Check the host pages for current dates before you drive.
train_links: The one-third-size Pullen Park Train runs its Holiday Express in December 2026, with tickets at $21.
traditions: A downtown tree lighting with vendors, food trucks, live performances, Santa and a 7 pm countdown.
A free Town of Garner afternoon with kids crafts, games, music and the Garner Express train.
A Main Street parade presented by the Garner Optimist Club with a new theme each year.
Santa joins both Light Up Main and the Holiday Block Party.
kidfact: The Garner Express train at the Holiday Block Party holds 24 people and rides around the walking trail, so it is a real train ride you can take in town.
faq: What Christmas events can kids enjoy in Garner?

Families can go to Light Up Main in downtown Garner, the free Holiday Block Party at the Garner Recreation Center with its Garner Express train, the Garner Optimist Christmas Parade on Main Street and the Christmas Town Festival at the Home Depot lot on Timber Drive. Each listing has its own date, time and price on its page.
Is the Garner Christmas parade free?

Yes, public parades are free to watch, and the Garner Optimist Christmas Parade is a public parade on Main Street. The parade website lists safety checks with the Garner Police Department and sells long sleeve parade T-shirts at the Optimist tree lot or beside the big tree on parade day.
Can kids meet Santa in Garner?

Yes. Santa visits the Light Up Main tree lighting in downtown Garner, and families can get pictures when Santa joins the Holiday Block Party at the Garner Recreation Center. Both listings link to the host page, where you can check the current schedule before you go.
Is there a train ride in Garner?

The Holiday Block Party offers the Garner Express, a 24 person train ride along the outdoor walking trail. It is a short ride and part of a free event, so check the Town of Garner page for current times. For a larger Christmas train, Pullen Park in Raleigh runs its Holiday Express.
